newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs end firmer, but end investors scarce.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs end firmer, but end investors scarce.

text.p: Belgian OLOs ended firmer with Bunds on Tuesday after a volatile last hour of trading, and the tone was expected to stay bullish though end investors remained scarce.
"It was very quiet, then in the last hour U.S. Treasuries rallied and Bunds reached a historic high. Then everything in the U.S. started being sold again," one dealer said.
"Generally the (Belgian) market's pretty quiet -- everyone is preparing for the year end," he added.
The benchmark 2006 OLO finished with a yield of 5.95 percent, down from 5.98 at the close on Monday.
